task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-02 at src/design/adp-02-tenant-columns-definition-instance-audit.md. Define additive tenant_id introduction on process definition, process instance, task, transition, and audit tables as required by ADP-02, preserving default-tenant compatibility for legacy flows. Specify migration strategy (nullable vs backfill/default), index and uniqueness adjustments, query/filter semantics, and write-path invariants that prevent cross-tenant reads/writes. Include deterministic behavior for missing tenant context and expected error handling boundaries. Map API tenant-context assumptions to storage contract without implementing middleware. Include a traceability matrix mapping ADP-02 to impacted baseline requirements (PD-01, PD-07, EE-01, OBS-03) and regression obligations.
acceptance_criteria: Design specifies additive tenant_id schema changes and indexing for all ADP-02 tables
Read/write semantics and default-tenant compatibility behavior are explicit and testable
Cross-tenant isolation invariants are clearly defined for storage and query paths
Traceability matrix maps ADP-02 behavior to impacted PD/EE/OBS requirements
Output is implementation-ready for BACKEND-DEV without interpretation gaps

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-02 tenant columns on definition, instance, task, transition, and audit persistence with migration/index strategy, tenant-scoped invariants, deterministic error boundaries, and traceability mapping.
